AUTHOR: Bai
TITLE: Multi-Class Marine Organism Detection Using Multi-Scale Attention-Enhanced YOLO11n
REGION: BrackishMOT (brackish strait, Denmark; location not stated in paper)
SPECIES: Fish, small fish, crab, shrimp, starfish, jellyfish (coarse categories)
DATA: BrackishMOT public dataset (predefined train/val: 10,999 / 3,018 label files)
V_EV: Sec. 3.1: BrackishMOT 'contains real underwater video sequences captured in brackish and visually degraded environments. These scenes include turbidity, low contrast'
D2: Predefined BrackishMOT train/val (10,999 / 3,018 label files); validation used as test
D_EV: Sec. 3.2: 'The class distributions of the predefined training and validation subsets ... No additional random frame-level re-splitting was performed.' (split unit not stated)
R_EV: Abstract/Sec. 3.1: 'The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on the publicly available BrackishMOT dataset' (single dataset)
C_EV: Table 1: 'Inference Confidence threshold 0.3; NMS threshold 0.7' - not justified (F1 peaks at 0.183, Fig. 8).
E_EV: Abstract/Table 3: 'The proposed model achieves an overall mAP@0.5 of 0.481' (detection metrics only)
ARCH: YOLO11n + CBAM attention + CIoU loss (trained from scratch)
METR: Precision, recall, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95, per-class AP, F1-confidence curves, GFLOPs, params
NOTE: Predefined BrackishMOT split (Brackish/BrackishMOT predefined split; original unit per lead-author note is frame-based/predefined) but this paper does not state the split unit -> D_ALL NR. No separate test set: validation subset used for reporting. Inference threshold 0.3 reported; F1-confidence curve analysis reported (F1-max at 0.183) though 0.3 was not justified as the F1-max -> coded P as threshold sensitivity is reported; verifier may consider N. Trained from scratch (no pretrained weights). Fish not resolved to species (fish vs small fish).
